identity_semantics.asset_identity: Each asset_sha256 is the independent checksum-bound identity of the exact authorized audio bytes. It is binding evidence and is not an input to the source UUID derivation.
identity_semantics.ordinal_semantics: The numeric suffixes distinguish opaque instances only. They encode no instrument, musical, processing-order, priority, or temporal meaning.
identity_semantics.source_identity: The AD-041 direct-input source UUID is derived only from the shared source_authority_id and the bound opaque source_instance_key under jga-direct-input-source-identity/v1.

replay_invariant: Replaying the same authorized binding under AD-041 MUST reproduce the same source identity. A different independently authorized source instance MUST receive a different opaque key even when its display or stem name is also Mix.
